description.en: Fades the out-of-focus blur ("boke") to a given strength over a number of frames, then turns the effect off. It is the counterpart of CMND_BOKE_CREATE; the game fades it to 0.0 at the end of each dialogue scene (ev_main's EndStandEvent).
Strength to fade to before the effect is removed, normally 0.0.
Length of the fade-out, in frames.

true once the fade-out has been started.
null if the engine is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.

examples.case: Ending a dialogue scene (real usage, from ev_main's EndStandEvent)
